nodes.label: Graph Semantic Zones Plan
nodes.description: AlertRule is the threshold source of truth for chart zones. Semantic mapping: green (no rule violated), amber (warning rule), red (danger rule), info (info rule, separate band), neutral (no applicable rule). Precedence: danger > warning > info > normal. Frozen boundary semantics (GRAPH-004): AlertService inclusive semantics (value <= min_value or value >= max_value). Architecture: AlertRule → AlertService rule-resolution → RuleToGraphZones normalizer (NEW, single owner) → public/authenticated projection → SensorReadingChart. Vue must not reimplement AlertService. Public exposure: only graph-safe projection (ordered severity intervals {from, to, severity}), no rule ids, no scope. Issue backlog: GRAPH-001 through GRAPH-013, TEST-001 through TEST-005. Done when: one server-owned normalizer, chart paints green/amber/red/neutral, no-rules renders neutral, tests pass.
nodes.rationale: Defines the chart semantic zones architecture. Establishes AlertRule as the single source of truth, the precedence rules, and the normalizer pattern that prevents Vue from reimplementing AlertService evaluation.
